endpoints.name: Profile
endpoints.description: The account the credentials belong to, with its settings. One record, always the caller.

endpoints.name: Searches
endpoints.description: The SAVED SEARCHES defined on the account, each with its criteria and the record type it applies to. Most listing endpoints here accept a search_id, so these are reusable, organisation-approved definitions -- and reading their criteria is usually the fastest way to learn what a business term means here.

endpoints.name: Notes
endpoints.suffix: /v3/notes.json?deal_id={Deal ID?}&person_id={Person ID?}&company_id={Company ID?}&search_id={Search ID?}&conditions[activity_modified][from_date={Activity Modified From?:YYYY-MM-DD}&conditions[activity_modified][to_date]={Activity Modified To?:YYYY-MM-DD}
endpoints.description: The notes recorded against deals, people and companies, filterable by any of them. The qualitative record beside the structured one, and where the reasoning behind a deal's outcome is usually written.

endpoints.name: Note
endpoints.description: One note by id.

endpoints.name: Account Notifications
endpoints.description: The notifications raised for users, filterable by user. The alert record rather than any CRM data.

endpoints.name: Account Notification
endpoints.description: One notification by id.

endpoints.name: Calendar Events
endpoints.description: The scheduled meetings, calls and tasks, filterable by conditions or a saved search. Carries the type, times, attendees and the records each relates to. The activity table.

endpoints.name: Calendar Event
endpoints.description: One calendar event by id.

endpoints.name: Comments
endpoints.description: The comments on one note. Requires a note id. Notes carry discussion, so this is the thread beneath one.

endpoints.name: Comment
endpoints.description: One comment by id. Requires the note id.

endpoints.name: Company Comments
endpoints.description: The comments on one note attached to a company. Requires the company and note ids.

endpoints.name: Deal Comments
endpoints.description: The comments on one note attached to a deal. Requires the deal and note ids.

endpoints.name: People Comments
endpoints.description: The comments on one note attached to a contact. Requires the person and note ids.

endpoints.name: Company Notes
endpoints.description: The notes on one company. Requires a company id.

endpoints.name: Company People
endpoints.description: The contacts at one company. Requires a company id.

endpoints.name: Company Deals
endpoints.description: The deals with one company. Requires a company id.

endpoints.name: Company Calendar Entries
endpoints.description: The calendar events involving one company. Requires a company id.

endpoints.name: Companies
endpoints.description: The organisations contacts and deals belong to, with name, address, website, owner, tags and custom fields. The account-level dimension.

endpoints.name: Company
endpoints.description: One company by id.

endpoints.name: Deals
endpoints.description: The sales opportunities -- the central table. Carries the name, value, the company and primary contact, the stage, probability, expected close date, status, owner, source and custom fields. NOTE THE FILTERING MODEL, which is uniform across this connector: listings take conditions[field] parameters rather than a query language, and a search_id referencing a SAVED SEARCH. Those saved searches encode the segments the business already agreed on, which is usually faster than reconstructing a filter.

endpoints.name: Deal
endpoints.description: One deal by id.

endpoints.name: Deal Notes
endpoints.description: The notes on one deal. Requires a deal id.

endpoints.name: Deal People
endpoints.description: The people associated with one deal. Requires a deal id. A deal names one primary contact; this is everyone involved.

endpoints.name: Deal Calendar Entries
endpoints.description: The calendar events linked to one deal. Requires a deal id. The meeting history behind an opportunity.

endpoints.name: Documents
endpoints.description: The files stored, filterable by name. Metadata rather than content.

endpoints.name: Document
endpoints.description: One document by id.

endpoints.name: Person Notes
endpoints.description: The notes on one contact. Requires a person id.

endpoints.name: Person Deals
endpoints.description: The deals one contact is involved in. Requires a person id.

endpoints.name: Person Calendar Entries
endpoints.description: The calendar events involving one contact. Requires a person id.

endpoints.name: People
endpoints.description: The contacts, with name, contact details, the company, owner, lead source and status, tags and custom fields. Filterable by conditions or a saved search.

endpoints.name: Person
endpoints.description: One contact by id.

endpoints.name: Company Custom Groups
endpoints.description: The custom field groups defined for companies.

endpoints.name: Company Custom Group
endpoints.description: One company custom field group by id.

endpoints.name: Company Custom Labels
endpoints.description: The custom field definitions for companies. The decoder for custom values on a company.

endpoints.name: Company Custom Label
endpoints.description: One company custom field by id.

endpoints.name: Company Custom Label Entries
endpoints.description: The dropdown options of custom fields, with their stored values and display text. THE SECOND HALF OF THE DECODER: a dropdown custom field stores an option id, and only this resolves it to something readable.

endpoints.name: Company Custom Label Entry
endpoints.description: One custom field dropdown option by id.

endpoints.name: Deal Custom Groups
endpoints.description: The custom field groups defined for deals. Fields are organised into groups, so this is the outer level of the custom-field schema.

endpoints.name: Deal Custom Group
endpoints.description: One deal custom field group by id.

endpoints.name: Deal Custom Labels
endpoints.description: The custom field definitions for deals, with their labels and types. THE DECODER for custom values on a deal, which arrive keyed by label id.

endpoints.name: Deal Custom Label
endpoints.description: One deal custom field by id.

endpoints.name: Deal Loss Reasons
endpoints.description: The reasons configured for losing a deal. The structured explanation for revenue not won, which the deal's status alone does not give.

endpoints.name: Deal Loss Reason
endpoints.description: One loss reason by id.

endpoints.name: Deal Stages
endpoints.description: The pipeline stages, with name, position and probability. The dimension a funnel breakdown joins to, and the decoder for a deal's stage id.

endpoints.name: Deal Stage
endpoints.description: One deal stage by id.

endpoints.name: Documents Tags
endpoints.description: The tags applied to documents. The classification of stored files.

endpoints.name: Document Tag
endpoints.description: One document tag by id.

endpoints.name: Event Categories
endpoints.description: The categories calendar events are classified under. The decoder for an event's category, and the dimension that turns activity volume into activity type.

endpoints.name: Event Category
endpoints.description: One event category by id.

endpoints.name: Lead Sources
endpoints.description: The lead source values configured. The attribution dimension -- where deals and contacts came from -- and account-specific.

endpoints.name: Lead Source
endpoints.description: One lead source by id.

endpoints.name: Lead Statuses
endpoints.description: The lead status values configured. The decoder for a contact's status, and the stages before a deal exists.

endpoints.name: Lead Status
endpoints.description: One lead status by id.

endpoints.name: Note Categories
endpoints.description: The categories notes are filed under. The decoder for a note's category, and the closest thing to a structured classification of what activity a note represents.

endpoints.name: Note Category
endpoints.description: One note category by id.

endpoints.name: Person Custom Groups
endpoints.description: The custom field groups defined for contacts.

endpoints.name: Person Custom Group
endpoints.description: One person custom field group by id.

endpoints.name: Person Custom Labels
endpoints.description: The custom field definitions for contacts. The decoder for custom values on a person.

endpoints.name: Person Custom Label
endpoints.description: One person custom field by id.

endpoints.name: Predefined Contact Tags
endpoints.description: The tag vocabulary available for contacts. Where tags are predefined rather than free text, this is the complete set.

endpoints.name: Predefined Contact Tag
endpoints.description: One predefined contact tag by id.

endpoints.name: Teams
endpoints.description: The teams users belong to. The grouping above individuals for reporting.

endpoints.name: Team
endpoints.description: One team by id.

endpoints.name: Todo Templates
endpoints.description: The task list templates defined -- the standard sequences of work a deal or contact triggers. What a team considers its repeatable process.

endpoints.name: Todo Template
endpoints.description: One todo template by id.

endpoints.name: Todo Template Items
endpoints.description: The individual steps within todo templates. The detail of the process.

endpoints.name: Todo Template Item
endpoints.description: One todo template item by id.

endpoints.name: Users
endpoints.description: The users of the account, filterable by email, admin flag and user level. Every record carries an owner, so this is the dimension per-person performance joins to. Inactive users are excluded unless explicitly included, and they still own their historical records.

endpoints.name: User
endpoints.description: One user by id.

endpoints.name: Revenue Types
endpoints.description: The revenue types deals can be classified as -- one-off, recurring, and whatever else the business defined. The dimension that separates kinds of revenue, which the deal value alone conflates.

endpoints.name: Revenue Type
endpoints.description: One revenue type by id.
